"Closer" initially performed better than its predecessor, "How Does Your Garden Grow? ", peaking at #110 on the Billboard charts.  The first single off the album, "Extra Ordinary," placed on both the Billboard Modern Rock and Adult Top 40 charts (it was the eighth and last BTE single to date to place on the Modern Rock charts).  A second single, "Misunderstood," was planned, but Beyond Records declared bankruptcy before it could be released.
